chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddaq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:

I asked him about a man who performs salat (prayer) and puts his hand inside his garment. He said: If he is wearing another garment, a waist-wrapper or trousers, then there is no problem. But if he is not, then that is not permissible for him. And if he puts in one hand and does not put in the other, then there is no problem.

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is unobjectionable

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place a hand inside one's garment during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about placing the hand inside one's garment during salat (prayer). It distinguishes between cases where the person is covered by another garment and where he is not, indicating permissibility in the first case and non-permissibility in the second, while allowing the insertion of one hand alone.
